component.name: OpenPete
component.summary: Play your own Spyro the Dragon disc, recompiled for your PC

description.p: OpenPete plays Spyro the Dragon (PlayStation, 1998) natively on a PC — widescreen, high framerate, HD texture packs — while keeping gameplay bit-identical to original PlayStation hardware.

No game content is shipped. On first run OpenPete reads a disc image you supply, recompiles the game's code for your machine with the bundled toolchain, and keeps the result in its disc library; after that the original file is never needed again.
